newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ total hrly private sector earnings up in Feb yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ total hrly private sector earnings up in Feb yr.

text.p: Average total hourly earnings of private sector employees rose 3.7 percent to NZ$15.85 in the year to February 1997, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
The provisional results are part of SNZ's Quarterly Employment Survey for February, the remainder of which has been delayed until June 12.
The increase was equal to the 3.7 percent rise in the year to November 1996, SNZ said.
Ordinary time average hourly earnings in the private sector increased 3.6 percent in the year to February to $15.68. The increase in the year to November 1996 was 3.8 percent.
